header.name: Olympus SMP Behavior v3.5.11
header.description: v3.5.11 | Hestia: easy toolbox with seven resource-powered building tools, 24 undo/redo steps; Athena: enchanting workshop and earned bonus mob XP; Artemis: darkness double jump, Moon Bow aim assist, tracking, conditional invisibility/sprint. Poseidon: v3.4.4 movement/release and locked Tidecaller, held-trident/rain landing clutch. Weather probes stay away from players. Zeus: live Y220/thunder sky power. Includes Forge, Crown, Tool Vault, native animations, optional Vibrant Visuals and upgrade_gods command.
